subject: alt-d
title: (R)ALT.D.------AFI.
description: Chart on book p. 80 (WAM-22). ALT-D (alternative definitions) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AFI (affinity insight) is the partner, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of". From AFI: ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism). From ALT-C-PG: ATTN (attraction). From ATTN: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). IST-F (isolated focus), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", is on a dotted line from ATTN. RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) is on a dotted line from INFO-AF-B.
